info.title: Pi Ecosystem Intelligence API
info.description: Discover. Analyze. Compare. — Independent analytical indicators about the Pi ecosystem. All responses use { data, meta } or { error: { code, message } }. Scores are analytical indicators, not verdicts; missing data is null, never 0; responses containing fictional data set meta.containsDemoData.
